info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Promotional Events Management API
info.description: The Promotional Events Management API allows businesses to create and manage promotional events effectively. This endpoint supports the initiation of new promotional campaigns, enabling marketers to attract customers through targeted offers. Typical consumers include marketing teams and business analysts who leverage this API to enhance customer engagement and boost sales. By integrating this API, businesses can streamline their promotional strategies and monitor event performance seamlessly.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new promotional event in the marketing system. You need to provide the necessary details for the event in the request body. Once the event is created, it can be managed and tracked through the marketing platform.
